summary: The downloaded-release verification gap was fixed; issue #71 now passes the full verification and production audit gates.

findings.description: The strict downloaded-release verifier and mismatch tests were dead code: production bootstrap only checked files independently against SHA256SUMS, then ignored whether provenance, the download manifest, and the installer-bundled manifest described the same commit, runtime digest, platform, and artifact set. Bootstrap now runs the verifier from a freshly checksum-verified installer archive before writing versioned installer files or launchers.
